**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement satisfies the **preferred** position of the EXCLUSIVITY rule — AbbVie carries no exclusivity, non-compete or sole-supplier obligation anywhere in the document. The exclusivity that does exist runs in our favor (Harpoon may not develop or commercialize Competing Products, and the §5.1.3 licence is exclusive to AbbVie even against Harpoon), and per the detection guidance that is expressly not a deviation. Our sourcing freedom is further reinforced by AbbVie's unilateral rights to appoint distributors, co-promoters and third-party manufacturers, and to demand a manufacturing technology transfer to a designee of its choice.
